description: Merges follow-up details into an existing waitlist record. Requires the edit_token returned by join_waitlist - email alone never authorizes a merge. A repeat with nothing new returns already: true. All detail fields optional: name, company, role, context (one line: what they sell), why (the problem they are solving), question (anything they want to ask).

email.description: The email used at join time.

question.description: Anything they want to ask Clair.

why.description: What brought them here - the problem to solve.

name: update_waitlist
title: Add details to a waitlist record
